---
title: "04 — Q3: consensus voting"
author: "Adrien Taudière"
---

Effect of consensus voting across methods, databases and parameters
(`comparpq::resolve_taxo_conflict()`; columns built in
`01_load_and_clean.qmd`). Figures: Q3.2 (consensus vs single methods), Q3.3
(`nb_agree_threshold` sweep), Q3.5 (method × DB heatmap justifying the
`preference` strategy).

Every section has one tab per mock and ITSx region (`analysis_views()` in
`00_setup.R`), on the ASVs: Pauvert ITS1, then Tedersoo ITS1, ITS2 and full.
The figures are saved once per view, suffixed with it.

```{r setup}
here::i_am("analysis/04_q3_consensus.qmd")  # _quarto.yml would otherwise make here() root = analysis/
source(here::here("analysis/00_setup.R"))
res_all <- cache_read("res_comp_tax")
views <- analysis_views(res_all)
```

## Summary

```{r summary-data}
#| include: false
# Computed from the same views and filters as the tabs below: the consensus
# columns of Q3.2 (aside reading, not strict, nb_agree 1) against the single
# methods at default settings.
s04_rows <- view_rows(res_all, views) |>
  filter(metrics == "F1_score", tax_level == "Genus")
s04_cons <- s04_rows |>
  filter(is_consensus, !consensus_strict, nb_agree == 1L) |>
  filter(algo %in% paste0(c("preference", "rel_majority", "abs_majority", "consensus", "unanimity"), "_consensus")) |>
  transmute(view, tax_level, strategy = sub("_consensus$", "", algo), value = values)
s04_single <- s04_rows |>
  filter_default_settings() |>
  group_by(view, tax_level) |>
  summarise(best_single = max(values), mean_single = mean(values), .groups = "drop")
s04_best_cons <- s04_cons |>
  best_of("strategy", by = c("view", "tax_level")) |>
  left_join(s04_single, by = c("view", "tax_level")) |>
  mutate(gain_best = value - best_single, gain_mean = value - mean_single)
s04_g <- filter(s04_best_cons, tax_level == "Genus")
s04_beats <- function(x) {
  n <- sum(x$gain_best > 0)
  if (n == 0) {
    "in no view"
  } else if (n == nrow(x)) {
    "in every view"
  } else {
    paste0("in ", n, " of ", nrow(x), " views")
  }
}
s04_both <- s04_g
s04_word <- if (all(s04_both$gain_mean > 0) && mean(s04_both$gain_best > 0) <= 0.5) {
  "A consensus therefore protects against a poor choice of method and database more than it improves on the best one."
} else if (all(s04_both$gain_best > 0)) {
  "A consensus therefore improves on the best single column in every view and rank."
} else {
  "The consensus gain is mixed across views and ranks."
}
```

ASVs; each consensus votes over the 36 single columns at default settings
(chapter 01). Compared per view with the best single column and with the mean
of the 36.

- **Genus**: the best strategy is `r best_phrase(s04_g, "strategy")`.
  It beats the best single column `r s04_beats(s04_g)` (difference
  `r fmt_range(s04_g$gain_best)`), and the mean single column by
  `r fmt_range(s04_g$gain_mean)`.
- **Species** is no longer a primary endpoint here (OD 43): it is read by
  exact and near match in chapter 09; the `Gen_sp` rows below are secondary.
- `r s04_word`

```{r summary-fig}
#| echo: false
fig_summary_04_consensus <- s04_cons |>
  mutate(
    strategy = factor(strategy, levels = c("preference", "rel_majority", "abs_majority", "consensus", "unanimity"))
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = strategy, y = value)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey60") +
  geom_hline(
    data = s04_single,
    aes(yintercept = best_single, linetype = "best single column"), colour = "firebrick"
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    data = s04_single,
    aes(yintercept = mean_single, linetype = "mean of the 36 single columns"), colour = "steelblue"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~view, nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "Consensus strategy", y = "Genus F1", linetype = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")
print(fig_summary_04_consensus)
save_fig(fig_summary_04_consensus, "fig_summary_04_consensus", width = 16, height = 7)
```

## Q3.2 — Consensus vs single-method (F1, MCC)

Conservatism gradient: preference < rel_majority < abs_majority < consensus <
unanimity. Single-method bars show mean ± SE across databases.

```{r q3-2, results = "asis"}
conservatism_order <- c(
  single_methods,
  "preference", "rel_majority", "abs_majority", "consensus", "unanimity"
)

view_tabs(res_all, views, function(res, v) {
  fig_q3_data <- bind_rows(
    res |>
      filter(metrics %in% c("F1_score", "MCC")) |>
      filter_default_settings() |>
      mutate(display_method = algo, type = "single"),
    res |>
      filter(metrics %in% c("F1_score", "MCC")) |>
      filter(algo %in% paste0(c("preference", "rel_majority", "abs_majority", "consensus", "unanimity"), "_consensus")) |>
      filter(!is_consensus | !consensus_strict) |>
      filter(nb_agree == 1L) |>
      mutate(display_method = gsub("_consensus$", "", algo), type = "consensus")
  ) |>
    mutate(
      tax_level      = factor(tax_level, levels = tax_order),
      display_method = factor(display_method, levels = conservatism_order)
    )

  fig_q3_consensus_vs_single <- fig_q3_data |>
    ggplot(aes(x = display_method, y = values, fill = type)) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "bar", position = position_dodge()) +
    stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar",
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), width = 0.25) +
    facet_grid(metrics ~ tax_level) +
    labs(x = "Method", y = "Value (mean ± SE across DBs)", fill = "Type") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  print(fig_q3_consensus_vs_single)
  save_fig(fig_q3_consensus_vs_single, paste0("fig_q3_consensus_vs_single_", v$id), width = 16, height = 7)
})
```

## Q3.3 — rel_majority nb_agree_threshold sweep (1, 2, 3)

Trade-off: higher threshold → fewer FP but more FN. Faceted by rank.

```{r q3-3, results = "asis"}
view_tabs(res_all, views, function(res, v) {
  fig_q3_nb_threshold <- res |>
    filter(metrics %in% c("F1_score", "MCC")) |>
    filter(algo %in% c(
      "rel_majority_consensus",
      "rel_majority_nb2_consensus",
      "rel_majority_nb3_consensus"
    )) |>
    mutate(tax_level = factor(tax_level, levels = tax_order)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = factor(nb_agree), y = values)) +
    geom_col() +
    facet_grid(metrics ~ tax_level) +
    labs(x = "nb_agree_threshold", y = "Value") +
    theme_bw()
  print(fig_q3_nb_threshold)
  save_fig(fig_q3_nb_threshold, paste0("fig_q3_nb_threshold_", v$id), width = 16, height = 7)
})
```

## Q3.5 — Method × DB heatmap justifying the preference strategy

Which (method, DB) combination does the preference strategy prefer, and is it
a good choice? The preferred cell (`preference_pattern` in `00_setup.R`, at
bootstrap 0.5) is highlighted in red; the preference-consensus F1 is annotated.

```{r q3-5, results = "asis"}
view_tabs(res_all, views, function(res, v) {
  heat_data <- res |>
    filter(metrics == "F1_score", tax_level == "Gen_sp") |>
    filter_default_settings() |>
    mutate(is_preferred = algo == preference_method & db == preference_db)

  # The consensus `method_db` carries its input ("ITS1_asv_preference_consensus"):
  # select it by `algo`.
  pref_f1 <- res |>
    filter(
      algo == "preference_consensus",
      metrics == "F1_score",
      tax_level == "Gen_sp"
    ) |>
    pull(values)

  fig_q3_heatmap <- heat_data |>
    ggplot(aes(x = db, y = algo, fill = values)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_tile(
      data = filter(heat_data, is_preferred),
      fill = NA, color = "red", linewidth = 1.5
    ) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      "F1 (Gen_sp)", option = "plasma", direction = -1,
      limits = c(0, 1), na.value = "grey90"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.5, size = 3,
      label = paste0("preference consensus F1 = ", round(pref_f1, 3))
    ) +
    labs(x = "Reference database", y = "Method") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  print(fig_q3_heatmap)
  save_fig(fig_q3_heatmap, paste0("fig_q3_heatmap_", v$id), width = 12, height = 4)
})
```

## Under Q2b (OD 44)

Every section above reads the lead truth rule, `no_truth_aside`: the real
units without a truth (best hit 90–99.5 % to a mock member) leave the
scoring, so the chapter measures the assignment step, not how well the
sequencing represents the community. Under `q2b` they stay in it, wrong when
named and missed when left NA (chapter 01, OD 44).

```{r q2b-data}
#| include: false
# The best consensus strategy (Q3.2 columns) against the best single column,
# per view: does the consensus still lose (or win) under Q2b?
s04_rule_rows <- function(rule) {
  view_rows(res_all, views, truth_rule = rule) |>
    filter(metrics == "F1_score", tax_level == "Genus")
}
s04_rules_strategy <- compare_truth_rules(function(rule) {
  s04_rule_rows(rule) |>
    filter(is_consensus, !consensus_strict, nb_agree == 1L) |>
    filter(algo %in% paste0(c("preference", "rel_majority", "abs_majority", "consensus", "unanimity"), "_consensus")) |>
    transmute(view, strategy = sub("_consensus$", "", algo), value = values)
}, "strategy")
s04_rules_vs_single <- compare_truth_rules(function(rule) {
  rows <- s04_rule_rows(rule)
  bind_rows(
    rows |>
      filter(is_consensus, !consensus_strict, nb_agree == 1L) |>
      filter(algo %in% paste0(c("preference", "rel_majority", "abs_majority", "consensus", "unanimity"), "_consensus")) |>
      group_by(view) |>
      summarise(value = max(values), .groups = "drop") |>
      mutate(column = "best consensus"),
    rows |>
      filter_default_settings() |>
      group_by(view) |>
      summarise(value = max(values), .groups = "drop") |>
      mutate(column = "best single column")
  )
}, "column")
```

The best consensus strategy at Genus `r rule_holds_phrase(s04_rules_strategy)`.
Which is higher, the best consensus or the best single column,
`r rule_holds_phrase(s04_rules_vs_single)`.

```{r q2b-table}
#| echo: false
knitr::kable(
  bind_rows(
    rename(s04_rules_strategy$table, column = strategy),
    s04_rules_vs_single$table |> filter(column == "best single column")
  ),
  col.names = c("Consensus strategy / column", names(s04_rules_strategy$table)[-1]),
  caption = "Genus F1 of each consensus strategy and of the best single column: no_truth_aside / q2b."
)
```
